messages:
Marta (mktg): Quick sync 1 hour before publish. Need final changelog blurb, docs URL, and rollout window. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/512 . Docs preview: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2-preview

Alex (eng): Plan: canary 08:30 PT at 5%, pin demo variant for webinar at 09:45 PT, promote to 100% by 11:30 PT if green. Adding rollback snippet to changelog.

Emily (docs): I uploaded the Console screenshot and CLI sample. Final docs URL will be https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2 by 15:00 PT. Added redirect from /optimize.

Priya (prod-marketing): Need the one-line benchmark for hero (latency @4k + cost). Alex?

Alex (eng): Use: "~40% median latency reduction at 4k context; ~30% token cost reduction with batching and quantization." Pasted into changelog.

Jamal (pm): Webinar demo must hit the pinned variant so attendees see stable behavior. Alex can you pin and confirm endpoint?

Alex (eng): Pinned variant: optimize-v2-demo. Demo endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/demo/optimize-v2 . Will tag deploy-bot for schedule.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Alex at 2026-04-08T08:30:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Marta (mktg): We're aiming to publish marketing at 12:00 PT. If eng wants a pause, say now.

Alex (eng): No pause. Rollout alerts set to page #eng-oncall if error rate > 0.9%.

Marta (mktg): Thanks all 1 launching at 12:00 PT. I'll update press kit with final docs link when live.

Emily (docs): Docs live and redirect in place.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: optimize-v2 -> 100% at 2026-04-08T11:32:00-07:00.

Marta (mktg): Launch live  great work everyone. We'll do a short retro tomorrow.
